Title: Question regarding Nos Bestial and other abilities

Messages.Author: Kyle
Messages.Body:
Is the Nosferatu Bestial's ability able to be used more than once per
a given untap phase? I'm not seeing "once per" on there and didn't
know if I am reading it incorrectly or if there's an unwritten rule I
do not know of.

This also goes for abilities like William Thorbecke's "During your
discard phase, William may burn 2 blood to untap a minion you
control."

Thanks in advance

Messages.Author: Shindo
Messages.Body:


Nosferatu Bestial :

+1 stealth action. Unique. Put this card into play. This card
represents a unique Nosferatu vampire with 2 capacity and basic
Animalism [ani]. The Bestial cannot act except to hunt, cannot cast
votes and cannot have equipment. During your untap phase, this Bestial
may employ a retainer from your hand that requires Animalism (he or
she must meet the requirements of the card). Pay the cost as normal.
This is not an action and cannot be blocked.

Both card text use the template "during X do Y" so you can do it only
once.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kyle wrote:
> Is the Nosferatu Bestial's ability able to be used more than once per
> a given untap phase? I'm not seeing "once per" on there and didn't
> know if I am reading it incorrectly or if there's an unwritten rule I
> do not know of.

Once per.

"During X, do Y" means once each X.

> This also goes for abilities like William Thorbecke's "During your
> discard phase, William may burn 2 blood to untap a minion you
> control."

Correct.
